verdict.rationale: Skyvern's own product page documents a global residential proxy network with country, state and city targeting, which covers the proxy and geo-targeting half of the story. Nothing in the evidence describes stealth or fingerprint-masking controls: the bot-bypass page quotes only CAPTCHA solving, which is a different capability. Missing for 10: documented stealth/fingerprint configuration, docs showing how to enable or select proxies per run, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can enable stealth fingerprinting and residential or geo-targeted proxies so legitimate automations aren't blocked as bots

citations.quote: Global residential proxy network with country, state, and city-level targeting across 20+ countries.
